subject: Refactored the ExpandCollapseAnimationTimer_Tick to reduce cognitive load.
body:
Refactored the ExpandCollapseAnimationTimer_Tick to reduce cognitive load.

Extracted per-container animation steps into AdvanceContainerAnimation for clarity. Moved expansion and collapse finalization to dedicated methods, improving code readability, maintainability, and separation of concerns.

triage.rationale: Pure extraction around an animation subsystem our tree lacks. The target method and state fields are absent, yielding no user-visible benefit and requiring prerequisite feature work.
